name: Sorik
summary: Sorik features a matte white marble top that brings a calm, refined brightness to the piece. The body and short legs are wrapped in dark grey matte elm veneer, adding depth and a smooth contemporary texture. The back and inner panels are finished in melamine for a clean, organized interior. A single tall leg painted in brass metallic introduces a warm accent, giving the design a balanced, modern sophistication. top with White Marble(Matte) , the body and two short legs cover with elm veneer in dark grey matt. the back and inner panels with melamine, The high leg painted in brass metallic. 200×43.5×80
